$comment: Operating policy for the Website Team. Autonomy is this file, not the agents. Level 4 = the team fixes, tests and ships the safe_to_automate list without asking. The never list does NOT move with the dial.

levels.2: Advisor — diagnose and propose; engineering opens PRs
levels.3: Implementer — implement approved changes without re-asking per file
levels.4: Operator — independently fix, test and deploy the safe_to_automate list
levels.5: Autonomous — continuous loop, escalating high-risk decisions

safe_to_automate: broken internal links and hrefs resolving to no mapped route
restoring whichever of nav-word / built-file / route is missing when the other two agree
missing alt where surrounding text supplies it
a missing skip link in a shared shell
metadata violating an invariant already tested in lib/seo/register.test.ts
regenerating committed pages when generated-current.yml fails
dependency and security updates within a minor version, tests green
anything reversible by a single git revert with no data change
requires_approval: ANY new factual claim, figure, citation or statement about Swechha — this gate does not move with the autonomy dial
deleting a page or removing a route from a derived map
database migrations and anything touching Neon
adding or removing a third-party integration
promoting an agent, or adding a recruit to .claude/agents/
never: merge a pull request that does not meet EVERY auto_merge condition
add a CSP host without the subresource that needs it, on the same commit
replace a font or image at its existing filename
delete code that has a test
write a sourced figure that has not passed the DOI/URL check
claim to have verified anything against the live site — production returns 403 to this machine
edit app/ believing it is what readers see
weaken, or propose weakening, anything in this file

allowlist.$comment: Never a recursive search from ~. Enforced by --allowedTools plus the working directory.

cadence.work: daily 09:00 local — observe, act on the safe list, open and merge PRs that pass every gate
cadence.review: Monday 09:00 local — the weekly review for the owner, written to the vault
cadence.$comment: launchd uses local time and does not fire while the Mac is asleep; a missed run happens at next wake.

auto_merge.$comment: Engineering may merge its own PR ONLY when every one of these holds. Any single failure stops it and the PR waits for a human. This is the one exception to 'never merge its own pull request' and it is conditional, not general. public/_pages is a build artefact: a specialist may never hand-edit it, but `npm run build:all` regenerating it is expected and allowed. guard-paths.sh enforces both halves by running once before the build and once after with --post-build.
conditions: the change is wholly within safe_to_automate
npm test passes with no new failures against the recorded baseline
npm run lint reports 0 errors and no increase in warnings over the baseline (42 as of 2026-09-11)
every claim in changed content passes scripts/website-team/verify-claims.py — DOIs resolve at Crossref, source URLs fetch, quotes appear verbatim; an unreachable source is not a pass
the diff touches no path in never_touch
the diff adds no factual claim, figure, citation or organisational statement
the whole change is revertible by a single git revert
never_touch: public/_pages/** (hand-edits only; the build may regenerate it)

inbox.$comment: The owner drops jobs here in Obsidian, from any device. The manager reads it at the start of every run, acts on what it can, and reports what it did under '## Inbox'. It cannot edit the file, so it never marks its own homework — the owner strikes items through.

fact_verification.$comment: Deterministic, no model involved. An agent checking its own citations is the failure that already happened here. Claim types: verified_fact (needs a resolving DOI or a verbatim quote, never a bare link), interpretation (needs a resolving source), analysis and opinion (no source, but must be labelled), uncertain (may never carry a figure).
human_approval_still_required_for: any claim about Swechha's own impact, programmes or achievements
anything the script cannot independently establish

model_routing.haiku: inspection, classification, deterministic transformation, summarising, format checks
model_routing.sonnet: ordinary coding, content editing, design review, SEO analysis, implementation
model_routing.opus: complex architecture, hard debugging, major design decisions, high-impact editorial judgement, arbitrating specialist disagreement
model_routing.$comment: The manager routes per brief. Before routing, it must ask whether the question is deterministic -- a script, test or grep answers those better and for nothing. An unknown model falls back to the default with a warning rather than losing the brief.

activity_log.written_by: scripts/website-team/log-event.py, called by run.sh and execute.sh only
activity_log.$comment: ★ Agents never write this. An observability layer an agent can write is one it can lie to, so every event is emitted by the shell around the agent -- before it starts, after it returns, on each gate result. An agent cannot mark itself green. Outside both repositories on purpose: telemetry is neither knowledge (the vault) nor code (git), and committing it would bury real history under machine noise.
